usage: jbus project add [-h] [--checkout CHECKOUT] [--scratch]
                        --project-id PROJECT_ID
                        name

positional arguments:
  name                  the home's directory name under the homes' state

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --checkout CHECKOUT   the path of the repo's main checkout
  --scratch             a scratch home with no repo, in place of --checkout
  --project-id PROJECT_ID
                        the T3 Code project's id
